title: Immigration officer names suppliers of 'clients' in 'pastillas' scheme
summary: A Bureau of Immigration whistleblower testified before the Sandiganbayan on Wednesday that several individuals supplied the names of Chinese nationals allegedly allowed to enter the Philippines…

blocks.text: A Bureau of Immigration whistleblower testified before the Sandiganbayan on Wednesday that several individuals supplied the names of Chinese nationals allegedly allowed to enter the Philippines without inspection under the so-called "pastillas" scheme.
